EASEMENTANDACCESSRESTRICTIONAGREEMENT This Agreement is made and entered into as of the Finance Law of the State of NewYork and Section 402 of the Not-For-Profit Corporation Law of the State of New York having its principal place of business at 213 So. 4th Street, Brooklyn, NY 11211, and Southside United Housing Development Fund Corporation, organized pursuant to Article XI of the Private Housing Finance Law of the State of New York and Section 402 of the Not-For-Profit Corporation Law of the State of New York, having its principal place of business at 213 So. 4 Street, Brooklyn, NY 11211 ("Los Sures") and 160 South 2nd Street Limited Partnership ("160 LP"), a New York Not-for-Profit Corporation with its principal place of business at 213 So. 4th Street, Brooklyn, NY 11211 WHEREAS, Los Sures is a related entity to and organized both 145 HDFC and 16Q LP for the purpose of owning and operating low income housing; and WHEREAS, 145 HFDC is the owner of the property known as Los Sures Senior Housing, 145 South 31d Street, Brooklyn, New York, more particularly described in Exhibit A WHEREAS, Los Sures is the fee title holder and 160 LP is the holder of all beneficial and equitable interests of the property known as 160 So. 2nd Street, Brooklyn, New York, 11211, more particularly described in Exhibit B attached hereto and incorporated herein by reference (the "2 Street Property"); and WHEREAS, the 3"d Street Property and the 2"d Street Property share a property Hne along their rear yard; and WHEREAS, the construction of improvements at the 3"d Street Property resulted in the removal of an access ramp from the parking lot of the 3"d Street Property to the rear building entrance to the 2nd Street Property. The improvements also included the construction of walkways, chain link fences, a planter, a bench, and a concrete wall separating the properties, except for the Easement Area (hereinafter defined); and WHEREAS, an area approximately /7 x 3Y feet of the 2"d Street Property was more particularly described in Exhibit C attached hereto and incorporated herein by reference(the "Easement Area"); and WHEREAS, the residents of both properties currently have access to each property. It is the desire of Los Sures, 145 HDFC and 160 LP to restrict the access of each property solely to the residents thereof. Further it is the desire of Los Sures and 160 LP to convey an exclusive right to use and maintain theEasementArea to 145HDFC.
